categories: 语法基础·介词后接成分总论

grammarPrimer.title: 介词后接什么？——从 doing 到一切名词性成分
grammarPrimer.category: 语法基础·介词后接成分总论
grammarPrimer.summary: 很多学生把「介词 + doing」当作机械口诀背诵，但doing只是冰山一角。介词本质上需要一个「名词性成分」做宾语——名词、代词宾格、动名词(doing)、名词性从句都可以。理解了这个底层原理，就不会在介词后乱加to do或原形动词。

principle.rule: 介词（to / at / in / of / for / from / with / about / on ...）后面必须接名词性成分（能充当名词角色的结构）。
principle.whyNotToDo: 不定式 to do 是「动词性」结构，不能直接作介词宾语。介词 to 和不定式 to 长得一样但本质不同——这是中国学生最易混淆的点。

fiveTypes.label: 名词 (Noun)
fiveTypes.explain: 介词后直接接名词，最简单的情形。

fiveTypes.label: 代词宾格 (Object Pronoun)
fiveTypes.explain: 介词后用宾格（me/him/her/us/them），绝不能用主格（I/he/she/we/they）。

examples.analysis: at + 宾格 me（不是 I）
with + 宾格 him（不是 he）
on + 宾格 them（不是 they）
with + 宾格 us（不是 we）

fiveTypes.label: 动名词 / doing (Gerund)
fiveTypes.explain: 动词要作介词宾语，必须变成动名词 V-ing。这是考试最高频的考点。注意：介词 to（如 look forward to）后面的 doing 也属于此类——这里的 to 是介词，不是不定式符号。

examples.analysis: in 可省略，但后面仍是 doing

examples.phrase: be/get used to getting up early
examples.analysis: to(介) + doing，不是 to get up！

fiveTypes.label: Wh-名词性从句 (Wh-Nominal Clause)
fiveTypes.explain: 介词后可以接 wh- 引导的名词性从句（包括 what/when/where/how/whether 等），整体充当介词宾语。

examples.phrase: think about what to do next
pay attention to what the teacher says
be interested in how it works
look forward to what you will bring

fiveTypes.label: That-名词性从句（少见但存在）
fiveTypes.explain: 介词后直接接 that 从句在现代英语中较少见（that 从句作介词宾语通常需要先加 the fact），但「介词 + the fact + that 从句」是标准书面语表达。

examples.phrase: be proud of the fact that he won
be aware of the fact that time is limited

grammarPrimer.keyTakeaway: 口诀：介词后面三类名——「名·代·doing」（名词、代词宾格、动名词），进阶再加「从句」行。关键是：绝不在介词后直接放动词原形或 to do（除非 to 本身是不定式符号，而非常规介词）。

confusablePrepositions.how: 介词 to 后面接名词/代词/doing；不定式 to 后面接动词原形。如何判断？看 to 前面的词——如果 to 前面是 look forward / be used / be accustomed / object 等，to 往往是介词。如果不确定，试着在 to 后面放一个名词，如果通顺就是介词。

pitfalls.title: a lot vs a lot of — 副词 vs 限定词

comparison.usage: 修饰动词/形容词，后面不接名词
comparison.eg: She reads a lot. / I'm a lot happier now.

comparison.usage: 后接可数名词复数或不可数名词
comparison.eg: A lot of people came.

commonMistakes.wrong: I have a lot books.
commonMistakes.right: I have a lot of books.
commonMistakes.explain: a lot 是副词，不能直接修饰名词

testExample.question: He reads ___ every day. He has ___ books at home.
options: A. a lot; a lot of
B. a lot of; a lot
D. a lot of; a lot of

pitfalls.title: every day vs everyday — 时间状语 vs 定语形容词

comparison.usage: 修饰动词，回答 When? 的问题
comparison.eg: I go to school every day.

comparison.meaning: 日常的、平常的（= daily / ordinary）
comparison.usage: 放在名词前面修饰名词
comparison.eg: This is an everyday problem.

commonMistakes.wrong: I go to school everyday.
commonMistakes.right: I go to school every day.
commonMistakes.explain: 修饰动词 go 要用时间状语 every day（两个词）

commonMistakes.wrong: This is an every day thing.
commonMistakes.right: This is an everyday thing.
commonMistakes.explain: 修饰名词 thing 要用形容词 everyday（一个词）

testExample.question: We have everyday English classes, and we speak English every day. (判断画线部分正误)
testExample.explain: everyday English classes ✓（形容词修饰名词）；every day ✓（状语修饰 speak）——原句恰好正确，但考试常颠倒出题

pitfalls.title: in the future vs in future — 将来某个时间 vs 从今往后

comparison.meaning: 在将来（某个不确定的时间）
comparison.usage: 中性描述未来
comparison.eg: Robots will do more work in the future.

comparison.meaning: 从今往后、今后（= from now on）
comparison.usage: 含警告/建议口吻
comparison.eg: In future, be more careful with your money.

commonMistakes.wrong: In the future, please arrive on time.
commonMistakes.right: In future, please arrive on time.
commonMistakes.explain: 对今后行为的告诫/建议用 in future

commonMistakes.wrong: Nobody knows what will happen in future.
commonMistakes.right: Nobody knows what will happen in the future.
commonMistakes.explain: 中性描述将来用 in the future

testExample.question: ___ please lock the door when you leave the office.
testExample.explain: 对今后行为的要求用 in future

pitfalls.title: each other vs one another — 两者 vs 三者及以上（传统区分）

comparison.usage: The twins help each other.
comparison.eg: The two friends hugged each other.

comparison.usage: All classmates help one another.
comparison.eg: The team members support one another.

commonMistakes.wrong: （现代英语中两者常混用，但教材分列，考试中可能要求区分）
commonMistakes.right: 按传统规则答题：两者用 each other，三人以上用 one another
commonMistakes.explain: 人教版7上和7下分别教授，说明教材有意区分

testExample.question: The twins love ___ very much. / All the students in the class help ___.

pitfalls.title: too many vs too much vs much too — 三胞胎彻底辨析

comparison.usage: too many + 可数名词复数
comparison.eg: too many people / too many mistakes

comparison.meaning: 太多（+不可数名词 / 修饰动词）
comparison.usage: too much + 不可数名词 / V + too much
comparison.eg: too much water / eat too much

comparison.pos: 副词短语（教材未直接收录，但学生易混）
comparison.usage: much too + adj / adv
comparison.eg: much too hot / much too fast

commonMistakes.wrong: There are too much people.
commonMistakes.right: There are too many people.
commonMistakes.explain: people 可数，用 too many

commonMistakes.wrong: This coffee is too much hot.
commonMistakes.right: This coffee is much too hot.
commonMistakes.explain: 修饰形容词 hot 用 much too

testExample.question: He ate ___ and felt sick. There was ___ food on the table.

pitfalls.title: a few / few / quite a few — 肯定 vs 否定 vs 相当多

comparison.meaning: 几个、一些（肯定含义：有，虽然不多）
comparison.eg: I have a few friends here, so I'm not lonely.

comparison.meaning: 几乎没有（否定含义：少到几乎没有）
comparison.eg: He has few friends. He feels lonely.

comparison.pos: 限定词短语（教材未直接收）
comparison.eg: Quite a few students passed the exam.

commonMistakes.wrong: He has a few money.
commonMistakes.right: He has a little money.
commonMistakes.explain: few/a few + 可数；a little/little + 不可数

testExample.question: I have ___ friends here, so I feel quite happy.
testExample.explain: 肯定含义+可数名词→a few

pitfalls.title: do exercises vs do exercise — 可数 vs 不可数

comparison.meaning: 做操/做练习题（可数，指具体的动作）
comparison.eg: do morning exercises / do math exercises

comparison.meaning: 锻炼身体（不可数，泛指体育锻炼）
comparison.eg: do exercise regularly to keep fit

commonMistakes.wrong: I do morning exercise every day.
commonMistakes.right: I do morning exercises every day.
commonMistakes.explain: 早操是一套具体动作，用复数 exercises

commonMistakes.wrong: You should do more exercises to stay healthy.
commonMistakes.right: You should do more exercise to stay healthy.
commonMistakes.explain: 泛指锻炼身体，用不可数 exercise

testExample.question: We ___ every morning to stay healthy, and we also ___ in math class.

pitfalls.title: used to do vs be/get used to doing — 过去习惯 vs 现在习惯

comparison.meaning: 过去常常做（现在不做了）
comparison.usage: used to + 动词原形
comparison.eg: I used to get up late, but now I get up early.

comparison.usage: be/get used to + 名词/doing（to是介词！）
comparison.eg: I am used to getting up early now.

commonMistakes.wrong: I am used to get up early.
commonMistakes.right: I am used to getting up early.
commonMistakes.explain: be used to 中的 to 是介词，后面接 doing，不是 do！

commonMistakes.wrong: I used to getting up late.
commonMistakes.right: I used to get up late.
commonMistakes.explain: used to do 后面接动词原形

testExample.question: He ___ (过去常常) smoke, but now he ___ (习惯) living a healthy life.

pitfalls.title: some day vs someday — 分开 vs 合并

comparison.meaning: 某一天（指具体的、不确定的一天）
comparison.eg: Let's meet some day next week.

comparison.meaning: 总有一天、有朝一日（= one day，指遥远的将来）
comparison.eg: Someday I'll travel around the world.

commonMistakes.wrong: （考试通常通过语境选择分开/合并形式）
commonMistakes.right: 具体某天→ some day；未来某天（梦想）→ someday

testExample.question: I hope someday I can visit Yunnan again.
testExample.explain: ✓：someday 指有朝一日（梦想），用合并形式正确

pitfalls.title: be made of vs be made from — 看得出 vs 看不出原材料

comparison.eg: The desk is made of wood. → 看得出是木头

comparison.pos: 动词短语（教材未直接收）
comparison.eg: Paper is made from wood. → 看不出是木头

commonMistakes.wrong: Paper is made of wood.
commonMistakes.right: Paper is made from wood.
commonMistakes.explain: 纸看不出木头的样子→ from

commonMistakes.wrong: The chair is made from wood.
commonMistakes.right: The chair is made of wood.
commonMistakes.explain: 椅子能看出木头的纹理→ of

testExample.question: The ring is ___ gold. / Wine is ___ grapes.
testExample.explain: 金戒指看得出金子→of；葡萄酒看不出葡萄→from

pitfalls.title: have fun (in) doing — 介词后必须用 doing

comparison.usage: have fun (in) doing sth（in 常省略，但 doing 保留）

commonMistakes.wrong: We had fun to swim in the sea.
commonMistakes.right: We had fun swimming in the sea.
commonMistakes.explain: fun 后面省略了介词 in，所以要用 doing，不能用 to do

testExample.question: The children had great fun ___ (play) in the park.

pitfalls.title: look forward to doing — to 是介词，不是不定式符号！

comparison.usage: look forward to + n./pron./doing（to 是介词！）

comparison.note: 同理：pay attention to, be used to, belong to, lead to 中的 to 都是介词，后面都可以接 doing
comparison.eg: pay attention to writing / be used to getting up early

commonMistakes.wrong: I look forward to see you.
commonMistakes.right: I look forward to seeing you.
commonMistakes.explain: 这是中国学生最高频错误之一！to 在这里是介词而非不定式符号

testExample.question: I'm looking forward to ___ (hear) from you soon.

pitfalls.title: be worth doing — 主动形式表被动含义

comparison.usage: be worth + doing（用主动形式，但含义可被动）

commonMistakes.wrong: The book is worth being read.
commonMistakes.right: The book is worth reading.
commonMistakes.explain: worth 后用主动形式的 doing，不用于被动

testExample.question: This movie is worth ___ (watch) a second time.

pitfalls.title: succeed in doing sth

comparison.usage: succeed in + n./doing

commonMistakes.wrong: He succeeded to pass the exam.
commonMistakes.right: He succeeded in passing the exam.
commonMistakes.explain: succeed 不能接 to do，只能接 in doing

testExample.question: He passed the exam. → He ___ ___ ___ the exam.

pitfalls.title: be good at / be interested in / dream of / stop…from — 全部接 doing

comparison.eg: She is good at dancing.
He is interested in collecting stamps.
She dreams of becoming a singer.
The rain stopped us from going out.
Keep on trying!
Don't worry about failing.
I'm thinking about changing my job.
I feel like going for a walk.

commonMistakes.wrong: 以上短语后面统一不能接 to do！
commonMistakes.right: 全部接 doing（动名词）
commonMistakes.explain: 这些短语末尾的词（at, in, of, from, on, about, like）都是介词，介词后面必须接名词性成分——动词变成 doing

testExample.question: Are you interested in ___ (join) the club?

pitfalls.title: help sb with sth vs help sb (to) do sth — 两种结构都要掌握

comparison.eg: He helps me with my English.
He helps me learn English.

commonMistakes.wrong: He helped me with learn English.
commonMistakes.right: He helped me with my English. / He helped me (to) learn English.
commonMistakes.explain: with 后接名词，不能接动词；两种结构不能混用

testExample.question: He helps me with my homework. = He helps me ___ ___ my homework.

pitfalls.title: prepare sth for sb — 为某人准备某物

comparison.structure: prepare + 某物 + for + 某人
comparison.eg: Mom prepared a big dinner for us.

comparison.structure: prepare + for + 某事（为…做准备）
comparison.eg: We are preparing for the exam.

commonMistakes.wrong: Mom prepared for us a big dinner.
commonMistakes.right: Mom prepared a big dinner for us.
commonMistakes.explain: prepare sb sth 不常见；用 prepare sth for sb

pitfalls.title: share sth with sb — 和某人分享某物

comparison.structure: share + 某物 + with + 某人
comparison.eg: I shared my lunch with him.

commonMistakes.wrong: I shared my lunch to him.
commonMistakes.right: I shared my lunch with him.
commonMistakes.explain: share 搭配介词 with，不是 to

pitfalls.title: agree with sb vs agree to sth — 介词决定宾语类型

comparison.eg: I agree with you.
He agreed to the plan.

comparison.meaning: 同意做某事（to 是不定式）
comparison.eg: She agreed to help us.

commonMistakes.wrong: I agree you.
commonMistakes.right: I agree with you.
commonMistakes.explain: agree 是不及物动词，不能直接接宾语，需要介词

pitfalls.title: give sb a lift / lend sb a hand — 固定双宾语

comparison.eg: Can you give me a lift?
Could you lend me a hand?

commonMistakes.wrong: give a lift to me / lend a hand to me → 语法没错但不自然
commonMistakes.right: give me a lift / lend me a hand（双宾语更自然）

pitfalls.title: show sb around — 带某人参观

comparison.eg: Let me show you around the school.

commonMistakes.wrong: Let me show around you.
commonMistakes.right: Let me show you around.
commonMistakes.explain: around 放在宾语之后，不是之前

pitfalls.title: work out — 解决 vs 锻炼

comparison.meaning: 解出（题目）、解决（问题）= solve
comparison.eg: Can you work out this math problem?
He works out at the gym every day.
Things worked out well in the end.

commonMistakes.wrong: （学生通常在阅读中遇到不熟悉的义项时理解错误）
commonMistakes.right: 根据上下文判断：接 problem 等词→解决；接地点/频率→锻炼；接 well→进展

testExample.question: ① He ___ the answer quickly. ② She ___ at the gym every morning.
testExample.explain: 句①解决=worked out；句②锻炼=works out

pitfalls.title: put 家族七胞胎 — put up/on/off/out/back

comparison.eg: put up a poster / a tent / your hand
put on a coat / a play / weight
put off the meeting
put out the fire
Put the book back on the shelf.

commonMistakes.wrong: put off 也可能被理解为'脱下'（实际是 take off）
commonMistakes.right: 脱下=take off；推迟=put off——中国学生经典混淆

testExample.question: Never ___ till tomorrow what you can do today.

pitfalls.title: take 大家族 — take up/over/off/place/part in/care of

comparison.meaning: 开始学/从事；占据（空间/时间）
comparison.eg: take up a hobby; The table takes up too much space.
take over the business
The story takes place in Beijing.
take part in the competition
take care of the baby

commonMistakes.wrong: The meeting was taken place last week.
commonMistakes.right: The meeting took place last week.
commonMistakes.explain: take place = happen，不及物，不能用于被动语态！

testExample.question: Great changes have ___ in China in recent years.
testExample.explain: take place 不能用于被动→排除B

pitfalls.title: look 家族 — look at/for/after/forward to/up/down on

comparison.note: 反义：look up to 尊敬（9上#7）

commonMistakes.wrong: I looked for my key and I looked for it everywhere but couldn't find it.
commonMistakes.right: I looked for my key everywhere but couldn't find it.
commonMistakes.explain: look for = 找（过程）；find = 找到（结果）

testExample.question: I ___ my glasses everywhere but I can't ___ them.

pitfalls.title: get 大家族 — get up/dressed/lost/over/into/to know

commonMistakes.wrong: Get up the difficulty.
commonMistakes.right: Get over the difficulty.
commonMistakes.explain: 克服困难=get over，不与get up混淆

pitfalls.title: turn 家族 — turn on/off/around → turn up/down（延伸）

commonMistakes.wrong: Turn on the radio louder. / Turn off the TV a bit.
commonMistakes.right: Turn up the radio. / Turn down the TV.
commonMistakes.explain: 调音量用 turn up/down；开/关用 turn on/off

testExample.question: The music is too loud. Please ___.

pitfalls.title: come 家族 — come out/across/true/up with/along

comparison.eg: Her new book came out last month.
I came across an old photo.
His dream came true.
come up with a good idea
Come along with me.

pitfalls.title: go 家族 — go + doing 结构 / go off/wrong/through/away

comparison.eg: go hiking/swimming/shopping/boating/fishing
The alarm went off at 7.
Something went wrong with the computer.
go through difficulties

pitfalls.title: think about vs think of — 考虑 vs 想起

comparison.eg: I'm thinking about whether to go.

comparison.meaning: 想起；认为（= come up with / have an opinion）
comparison.eg: I can't think of his name. / What do you think of the movie?

commonMistakes.wrong: I'm thinking of changing my job. → 这个句子其实两个都可以，但考试中 think about 强调'考虑的过程'，think of 更偏向'突然想到'或'评价'

testExample.question: What do you ___ the new teacher?
testExample.explain: What...think of... = 觉得…怎么样（固定句型）

pitfalls.title: hear from vs hear of — 收到来信 vs 听说过

comparison.eg: I haven't heard from my parents for a month.

comparison.meaning: 听说过（知道有这个东西/人）
comparison.eg: Have you ever heard of the Silk Road?

comparison.meaning: 听说关于某事（知道详情）
comparison.eg: I heard about the accident on the news.

testExample.question: —Have you ever ___ Gongbao chicken? —Yes, I often ___ my mother. She cooks it well.

pitfalls.title: be good at vs be good with — at 技能 vs with 人际/工具

comparison.eg: She is good at math / singing.

comparison.meaning: 善于和…相处 / 善于使用…
comparison.eg: He is good with children / computers.

testExample.question: Mr. Wang is good ___ kids. He is also good ___ playing basketball.

pitfalls.title: be different from vs be similar to — 反义但介词不同

commonMistakes.wrong: be different to / be similar with
commonMistakes.right: be different from / be similar to

pitfalls.title: be full of vs be filled with — 同义但结构不同

commonMistakes.wrong: The bottle is full with water. / The bottle is filled of water.
commonMistakes.right: full of / filled with

testExample.question: The room is full of people. = The room ___ ___ ___ people.

pitfalls.title: be tired of vs be tired from — 厌倦 vs 因…累

comparison.eg: I'm tired of eating the same food every day.
I'm tired from working all day.

testExample.question: I'm ___ this boring job. / I'm ___ running 10 kilometers.

pitfalls.title: be late for / be absent from / be on time — 固定介词

comparison.eg: Don't be late for school.
He was absent from the meeting.
Please be on time.

pitfalls.title: be proud of vs take pride in — 同义介词不同

comparison.eg: I'm proud of you.
I take pride in my work.

testExample.question: She is proud of her son. = She ___ ___ ___ her son.

pitfalls.title: be familiar with vs be familiar to — with 主动 vs to 被动

comparison.eg: I am familiar with this area.

comparison.meaning: 某事对某人来说是熟悉的
comparison.eg: This song is familiar to me.

pitfalls.title: in the end vs at the end of — 副词 vs 介词短语

comparison.meaning: 最终、最后（= finally / at last）
comparison.usage: 独立使用，不接 of
comparison.eg: In the end, we found the way home.

comparison.usage: at the end of + 名词
comparison.eg: at the end of the road / the month

testExample.question: ___ we solved the problem. / There is a hospital ___ the street.
options: A. In the end; at the end of
B. At the end; in the end of
C. In the end; in the end of
D. At the end of; at the end of

pitfalls.title: in time vs on time — 及时 vs 准时

comparison.eg: We got to the station just in time to catch the train.
The train arrived on time.

testExample.question: The doctor arrived just ___ to save the patient's life.

pitfalls.title: at night — 为什么 night 用 at 而 morning 用 in？

comparison.note: 英式用法；美式 on weekends
一天中的点时间用 at

pitfalls.title: at first vs first of all — 起初 vs 首先

comparison.eg: At first I didn't like him, but later we became friends.

comparison.meaning: 首先（用于列举，不暗示变化）
comparison.eg: First of all, let me introduce myself.

pitfalls.title: from now on vs from then on — 时态差异

comparison.eg: From now on, I will study harder.
From then on, he never lied again.

pitfalls.title: in front of vs in the front of — 外部前面 vs 内部前部

comparison.eg: There is a tree in front of the house.
The driver sits in the front of the car.

testExample.question: The blackboard is ___ the classroom.
testExample.explain: 黑板在教室内部的前面→in the front of

pitfalls.title: not only...but also... — 倒装考点

comparison.key: Not only 置于句首时，该分句要倒装
comparison.eg: Not only does he like music, but he also plays the piano.

commonMistakes.wrong: Not only he likes music, but also he plays the piano.
commonMistakes.right: Not only does he like music, but he also plays the piano.
commonMistakes.explain: Not only 在句首→部分倒装（助动词提前）

testExample.question: He not only sings well but also dances well. → Not only ___ ___ ___ well, but he also dances well.

pitfalls.title: so...that... vs such...that... — 经典必考

comparison.eg: He runs so fast that nobody can catch him.
He is such a fast runner that nobody can catch him.

testExample.question: It was ___ fine weather that we decided to go hiking.
testExample.explain: weather 不可数→such（无a）；若说 such a fine day（可数）也对

pitfalls.title: neither...nor... — 就近原则

comparison.key: 就近原则：谓语动词与 nor 后的主语一致
comparison.eg: Neither he nor I am wrong.

commonMistakes.wrong: Neither he nor I are wrong.
commonMistakes.right: Neither he nor I am wrong.
commonMistakes.explain: nor 后是 I→用 am

commonMistakes.wrong: Neither I nor he are wrong.
commonMistakes.right: Neither I nor he is wrong.
commonMistakes.explain: nor 后是 he→用 is

pitfalls.title: as soon as / as long as — 主将从现

comparison.rule: 时间状语从句→主将从现
comparison.eg: I will call you as soon as I arrive.

comparison.rule: 条件状语从句→主将从现
comparison.eg: I will go as long as you go with me.

commonMistakes.wrong: I will call you as soon as I will arrive.
commonMistakes.right: I will call you as soon as I arrive.
commonMistakes.explain: as soon as 引导的从句用一般现在时表将来

pitfalls.title: only if vs if only — 语序不同，意思天差地别

comparison.meaning: 只有…才（= only when，真实条件）
comparison.eg: You can go only if you finish your homework.

comparison.meaning: 要是…就好了（虚拟语气，表达遗憾/愿望）
comparison.eg: If only I had studied harder!

pitfalls.title: by the time — 完成时态触发器

comparison.phrase: by the time + 过去时间
comparison.eg: By the time I arrived, the movie had started.

comparison.phrase: by the time + 将来时间
comparison.eg: By the time you arrive, I will have finished.

pitfalls.title: get dressed — dress 是及物动词的特殊用法

comparison.note: = be dressed = put on clothes。dress 是过去分词作表语
dress 是及物动词，宾语是人不是衣物

commonMistakes.wrong: Get dress. / Dress clothes.
commonMistakes.right: Get dressed. / Put on clothes.
commonMistakes.explain: dress 的宾语是人（dress sb），不是衣服

pitfalls.title: take a photo vs take photos — 单数 vs 复数
pitfalls.note: 同样模式：take a walk / take a shower / take a seat / take a deep breath 用单数；take notes 用复数

pitfalls.title: congratulations on — 必须复数！

comparison.note: 必须用复数 congratulations！不可说 congratulation。

commonMistakes.wrong: Congratulation on your success!
commonMistakes.right: Congratulations on your success!

pitfalls.title: be in one's forties — 几十几岁的表达

comparison.meaning: 在某人二十/三十/四十多岁时
comparison.note: 整十数加 s，变 y 为 ie 再加 s

commonMistakes.wrong: in his forty / in the forties
commonMistakes.right: in his forties（四十多岁）/ in the forties（四十年代）

pitfalls.title: thousands of / hundreds of / millions of — 虚指 vs 实指

comparison.eg: Thousands of people came.
Two thousand people came.

commonMistakes.wrong: two thousands / two thousands of
commonMistakes.right: two thousand（实指数字，不加s）

commonMistakes.wrong: thousand of
commonMistakes.right: thousands of（虚指，要加s+of）

testExample.question: Two thousands of students took part in the activity.

pitfalls.title: daily routines / do chores — 习惯用复数

comparison.note: 日常安排，routine 习惯用复数
做家务，chore 习惯用复数

pitfalls.title: because of vs because — 介词 vs 连词

comparison.usage: because of + 名词/代词/doing
comparison.eg: He was late because of the rain.

comparison.usage: because + 句子（主谓结构）
comparison.eg: He was late because it rained.

testExample.question: We stayed at home ___ the heavy rain. / We stayed at home ___ it rained heavily.

pitfalls.title: instead of vs instead — 介词 vs 副词

comparison.usage: instead of + 名词/代词/doing
comparison.eg: Let's walk instead of taking a bus.

comparison.usage: 独立使用，放句首或句末
comparison.eg: He didn't take a bus. He walked instead.

pitfalls.title: such as vs for example — 列举 vs 举例

comparison.usage: 例如（接名词/名词短语列举，不用逗号）
comparison.eg: I like sports such as basketball and tennis.

comparison.usage: 例如（接句子，通常有逗号）
comparison.eg: I like many sports. For example, I play basketball every weekend.

pitfalls.title: at the moment vs at that moment — 现在进行时 vs 过去进行时

comparison.eg: She is sleeping at the moment.
At that moment, she was sleeping.

pitfalls.title: so far — 现在完成时标志

comparison.meaning: 到目前为止（= up to now）
comparison.eg: So far we have learned 100 phrases.

commonMistakes.wrong: So far we learned 100 phrases.
commonMistakes.right: So far we have learned 100 phrases.
commonMistakes.explain: so far 是现在完成时的标志词

pitfalls.title: in fact / as a result / for this reason — 副词连接语辨析
not…at all — 一点儿也不

comparison.usage: not + 动词/形容词 + at all
comparison.eg: I don't like it at all.

pitfalls.title: quite a / quite a few — 强调限定词

comparison.phrase: quite a + 可数名词单数
comparison.eg: That's quite a story!

pitfalls.title: pick up 多义 — 捡起 / 接人 / 学会

comparison.meaning: ①捡起 ②(用车)接人 ③(无意中)学会 ④好转
comparison.eg: pick up the pen / pick me up at 5 / pick up some French / Business is picking up.

pitfalls.title: drop off / drop out — 多义区分

comparison.meaning: ①送（某人到某地）②打瞌睡 ③减少
comparison.eg: I'll drop you off at the station.
He dropped out of school.

pitfalls.title: go off 多义 — 闹钟响 / 爆炸 / 变质

comparison.meaning: ①（闹钟）响 ②爆炸 ③（食物）变质 ④离开
comparison.eg: The alarm went off. / The bomb went off. / The milk has gone off.

pitfalls.title: make up 多义 — 和好 / 编造 / 组成 / 化妆
fight against sb — 介词固定 with/against 辨析

comparison.eg: fight against the disease

comparison.meaning: ①与…打架/战斗 ②与…并肩作战（看上下文）
comparison.eg: fight with a friend / fight with the allies

pitfalls.title: worry about vs be worried about — 动词 vs 形容词

comparison.eg: Don't worry about me.
I'm worried about you.

pitfalls.title: put on vs wear vs dress — 穿上（动作）vs 穿着（状态）vs 给…穿衣

testExample.question: It's cold outside. Please ___ your coat. / She always ___ a red dress.

pitfalls.title: alone vs lonely — 客观独处 vs 主观孤独

comparison.meaning: 独自的（客观状态，不一定是负面）
comparison.eg: She lives alone but she doesn't feel lonely.
He felt lonely in the big city.

pitfalls.title: as...as... / not as(so)...as... — 同级比较

comparison.eg: He is as tall as his father.
He is not as tall as his father.

pitfalls.title: have to vs must — 客观必须 vs 主观必须

comparison.meaning: 不得不（客观需要/外部要求）
comparison.eg: I have to go now. It's getting dark.

comparison.meaning: 必须（主观认为/内在义务）
comparison.eg: I must study hard for the exam.

pitfalls.title: more than / less than — 比较句型（可与 no more than 对比）

comparison.eg: more than 100 people
less than 10 minutes
He has no more than 10 dollars.
He has not more than 10 dollars.
